limitations: This wrapper operates on admitted values and delegates serialization to rfc8785. It does not implement strict raw JSON/YAML admission, exact numeric field codecs, or native resource limits. The json.loads test illustrates exact-byte comparison, not a sufficient admission parser.

Raw duplicate keys and integer precision already discarded cannot be recovered. Preserve numeric lexemes until exact-integer or binary64 field semantics are known; do not silently narrow existing supported data.
Version attribute check is not installed artifact or import-origin proof. Pin and verify distribution custody through the ordinary lock and qualification path.
Upstream source tested, not installed distribution; no complete RFC 8785 conformance certification or native consumer suite run.
ECMAScript comparison is a verification oracle, not a second production implementation. Preserve external commitments and original-byte digest referents.
